verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant that could plausibly be asked to model a fundraising round, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows generic capabilities: running code, creating files and Artifacts, and shared workspaces. Nothing documents priced-round modeling (dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma cap tables) or sharing a scenario with counsel and investors, and generic building blocks earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors
